Definition: Elkanah, the name of several Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elkanah is the name of several Israelites. In Exodus 6:24, the text says "and Elkanah." The life behind the name is told on the Elkanah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elkanah matters because God knows His people by name, and Elkanah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
